source: On a version of Nuxt without renderer plugins, {0} registers the same file as a Nitro plugin, which needs {1} with {2} in your module's {3}. Nitro calls it with its app, whose {4} are the ones the renderer calls, so the plugin works there too as long as it only reads {5} and imports nothing a server of that version cannot resolve. If it does, pass the Nitro plugin to register instead:
